related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: Make environmental services accountable through evidence from real MNCS development, and make machine-native work easier to discover and carry out.

measurement_basis: The existing binding-evidence summary already derives exact provider, binding ID, and contract-revision invocation counts, completion counts, outcomes, and source events. The evidence-priority ECI response retained availability accountability but omitted those use fields. A same-session before/after projection readback confirms the omission and the new bounded summary. The selected 128-event window is truncated and contains no exact binding invocation, so this record does not claim that any agent used or needed a capability.
not_measured: whether agents used Environment capabilities outside the selected event window or through direct external tools
whether an agent received, discovered, or benefited from any capability
whether omitted use evidence caused manual intervention or changed a development outcome
whether the pressure recurs across sessions or projection budgets
whether any capability should be migrated from host code to MNCS

outcome.interpretation_limit: The baseline ECI response omitted a compact use summary even though the underlying binding summary contract carries exact-use fields. The live event page had no exact invocations and was truncated; this is an observability pressure, not evidence of missing capability use, agent burden, or service failure.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Evidence-priority compaction can drop exact capability-use context
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain a bounded summary of exact provider, binding, and contract-revision invocations with outcome and source-event counts beside availability, preserving event-window and agent-receipt uncertainty.
